newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-ENGLAND UNCHANGED FOR NEW ZEALAND BARBARIANS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-ENGLAND UNCHANGED FOR NEW ZEALAND BARBARIANS.

text.p: England coach Jack Rowell on Tuesday named the same side which comfortably beat Italy last weekend for the much sterner test against the New Zealand Barbarians at Twickenham on Saturday.

The major doubt had been over prop forward Jason Leonard who suffered a badly bruised elbow against Italy and Victor Ubogu, whose last international was a year ago against South Africa a year ago, had been placed on standby.
But Leonard passed a fitness test on Tuesday and trained with the England squad.
The other possible change was the return of number eight Ben Clarke, forced to pull out of the Italy match because of injury, but Rowell opted to retain his replacement Chris Sheasby.
Rowell said his policy was to stabilise a team for the World Cup in 1999.
"In the context of a good win over Italy the selectors thought that we had hit upon a side that had a good balance, especially in the back row. But it is hard luck on Ben."
Rowell said he regarded the game as an exercise in competing with the traditionally strong southern hemisphere teams.
"New Zealand lead the way in world rugby. They run northern hemisphere sides around -- as they did with us in the first half of the World Cup semifinal last year.

"But it wasn't only in that World Cup semifinal that we found we were unable to cope. When I first became manager, we found that we were not physically or mentally tough enough to compete against South Africa in the second test. I am looking for people who are physically and mentally combative."

England team - 15-Tim Stimpson; Jon Sleightholme, 13-Will Carling, 12-Phil de Glanville (captain), 11-Adedayo Adebayo; 10-Mike Catt, 9-Andy Gomersall; 8-Chris Sheasby, 7-Tim Rodber, 6-Lawrence Dallaglio, 5-Martin Johnson, 4-Simon Shaw, 3-Graham Rowntree, 2-Mark Regan, 1-Jason Leonard.
